Zooplankton by month

Zooplankton by month, all years

Filtered to action years (wet and an)

ggplotly(ggplot(zoop_summ_month %>%filter(actionyr == "*")) +
    geom_point(aes(x = factor(month), y = mnzoop, color = alt, shape = alt), size = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(taxa~hydro)+
    viridis::scale_color_viridis(option = "turbo", discrete = TRUE)+
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(20, 0, 18, 6, 8, 9, 10, 23, 1, 13, 14))+
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)))
